## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-4-5`, cutoff 2025-07-31) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [summary] = summary of both.

**ai** 4.3.16 → 7.0.142 (major)
- Removed; use the replacements: `CoreMessage` → `ModelMessage`, `convertToCoreMessages` → `convertToModelMessages`. [types]
- `streamText()` options no longer accept `maxTokens`, `maxSteps`, `toolCallStreaming`, `experimental_generateMessageId`, `experimental_continueSteps`, `experimental_providerMetadata` (+3 more); use `maxOutputTokens` instead of `maxTokens`; new options include `stopWhen` (Condition for stopping the generation when there are tool results in the last step; default `isStepCount(1)`), `output` (Optional specification for parsing structured outputs from the LLM response). [types]
- `tool()`: the `tool` argument no longer accepts `parameters`, `experimental_toToolResultContent`; the `tool` argument now requires `inputSchema` (The schema of the input that the tool expects). [types]

- remove deprecated `media` type part from `ToolResultOutput` [changelog]
- remove deprecated isToolOrDynamicToolUIPart function. [changelog]
- remove deprecated experimental_providerMetadata. [changelog]
